results.title: Profile page from a self-introduction
results.source: I'm Sam Ortiz, a landscape photographer based in Lisbon. For the last ten years I've photographed coastlines across Portugal and Spain, mostly at dawn, and my work has appeared in National Geographic Traveller and Monocle. Besides shooting, I run weekend workshops for beginners and the occasional week-long trip along the Alentejo coast. I've also published two photo books with a small press in Porto. I prefer the dark theme.
